title: flowCanvasChip-11665 test: the zh caption text is asserted before the flow label loads
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (a flaky test the seat met on a PR run) · Source: fleet (PR #37813, run 45941124060, job 140317738176)

## What happens

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.flowCanvasChip-11665.test.tsx`, the zh case: `caption()` returns as soon as `findByTestId('auto-canvas-caption')` finds the element, and line 164 asserts `toHaveTextContent(/^每日摘要$/)` synchronously. When the flow's label has not loaded yet, the chip still shows the API name `nightly_digest` and the case fails. It failed so on `Test UI (12/16)` of PR #37813, a PR that touches no `ui/` file. The title assertion two lines below is already wrapped in `waitFor`.

## Expected

The text assertion waits for the label the same way the title assertion does, so the case does not race the label fetch. The other cases in the file that read the label right after `caption()` get the same treatment where they can race.

## Done when

- [ ] The label-text assertions after `caption()` wait for the label (`waitFor` or `findByText`).
- [ ] The case still fails if the header prints the API name instead of the label.
